events.verdict: Philadelphia still has possession of the ball when the shot clock expires.
DeRozan (SAC) and Sabonis (SAC) contest Yabusele's (PHI) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Maxey (PHI) reaches in and makes contact with the ball and incidental contact with Sabonis's (SAC) hand on the ball.
Maxey (PHI) attempts to split the defenders and any lower body contact with DeRozan (SAC) and Fox (SAC) after he loses control of the ball is incidental.
Maxey (PHI) dribbles the ball off of Fox's (SAC) foot as he takes a step to continue defending.
Fox (SAC) collapses his right forearm and maintains a legal guarding position while he and Maxey (PHI) come together during the shot attempt.
Maxey (PHI) moves laterally towards Monk (SAC), but the body contact is marginal.
George (PHI) raises his arm to contests Monk's (SAC) driving shot attempt and incidental hand on ball contact occurs.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of a defensive goaltending Yabusele (PHI) is confirmed. Yabusele blocks the shot attempt after the ball reaches its apex and starts its downward trajectory.
DeRozan (SAC) initiates illegal contact across George's (PHI) side, affecting his SQBR and control of the ball.
George (PHI) reaches at Monk's (SAC) left arm as the ball is loose but the contact is marginal.
Gordon (PHI) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Fox (SAC).
Sabonis (SAC) and Yabusele (PHI) briefly lock arms in the lane.
George (PHI) initiates contact with Monk's (SAC) right arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Maxey (PHI) commits a take foul on DeRozan (SAC).
